releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.32:
- One-Touch Quick Cash Tender: Tapping $5, $10, $20, $50, $100 buttons instantly tenders payment, kicks the cash drawer, shows change due, and prints receipt without requiring extra clicks.
- Cash Tendered & Change Due on Receipts: Printed receipts clearly display Payment Method, Tendered Amount, and Exact Change Due.
- High-Speed Thermal Logo Auto-Inversion: Embedded GDI+ engine auto-detects dark-mode logos and inverts backgrounds to clean white, eliminating solid black thermal burn blocks and printing instantly.
- Instant 0ms Kitchen & Bar Order Bumping: Clicking Bump or pressing DEL/numpad removes the order from the screen immediately (0ms) and updates database status to 'listo' without freezing.
- Newest Orders First (Newest First Routing): New kitchen and bar tickets appear at position #1 in front of kitchen staff immediately.
- Hardware Screens & KDS Routing Sub-tab: Dedicated visual management tab in Options -> Hardware with direct URLs for Kitchen, Bar, Hostess, and Public TV.
- 100% Quality Bottle Standard: Certified with 41 automated pre-flight vector tests passing at 100.0% zero defects.
